energy_progress.message: I want to optimize the marketing messaging for my energy company. Conversion is about 5.5% and I want 7% over the next three months.

Residential homeowners see a paid search ad, visit our energy tariff page, request a quote, then sign a supply contract. Conversion means contracts signed divided by tariff-page visitors. We want to test the value proposition on that page. Traffic volume and intermediate step conversion are unknown; keep them unknown.
Print a concise first model and tell me where to open it. No more questions.
